sql: SELECT t.*, a.account_name, a.account_tier, a.duns_number, a.account_owner, a.billing_city FROM service_tickets t JOIN crm_accounts a ON a.account_id=t.account_id WHERE t.ticket_id='SR-39802'

sql: SELECT at, event, actor, detail FROM ticket_events WHERE ticket_id='SR-39802' ORDER BY julianday(at)

sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, a.duns_number, c.erp_customer_id, c.customer_name FROM crm_accounts a LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.duns_number=a.duns_number WHERE a.account_name LIKE '%Acme%' OR a.duns_number='09-552-1187'
